summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp., a Maryland-incorporated BDC, filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 124,395.879 Class I common shares for total consideration of $2,396,300, with the share count finalized September 18, 2026 from a September 1, 2026 subscription date. Sales were made under subscription agreements to accredited investors under Regulation D or non-U.S. persons under Regulation S, exempt under Section 4(a)(2). The filing also disclosed preliminary August 31, 2026 NAV per share of $19.26, total investments and unfunded commitments of $2.2 billion, and 0.97x debt-to-equity. This is a routine private placement, not a special situation.
